name: withdrawCash
intent: Debit the requested withdrawal amount from the current card and record the withdrawal in the session.
pre: The session password has been validated.
The session card ID has been validated.
A current session card is present.
The card balance is at least quantity.
post: Reduce the current card balance by quantity relative to its balance before this operation.
Record quantity as the session withdrawal amount.
Mark the session as having a withdrawal.
difficulty_basis: Balance arithmetic relative to the starting state plus session effects.
scenarios: 9999 minus 100 is 9899; withdrawal amount, flag and true result agree.
effects_audit: No positive-quantity guard, denomination rule, withdrawal limit or physical-cash side effect added; none appears in reference.
